curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: use the present tense realisations of the verbs ‘to be’ am, is and are to greet and introduce oneself and others

mission.title: Meet the Am, Is and Are Team

interactions.prompt: Tap the best way to introduce yourself.
interactions.feedback: Yes! We use am after I.

interactions.prompt: Match each person to the correct verb.
interactions.feedback: Great! I am, she is, they are.
interactions.retryHint: One other person uses is; more than one uses are.

interactions.prompt: Musa greets Wanjiku. Complete: Hello! You ___ Wanjiku.
interactions.feedback: Correct! We use are after you.

interactions.prompt: Put this friendly introduction in order.
interactions.retryHint: Greet first, name yourself, then introduce the other person.

interactions.prompt: Choose the sentence that introduces two friends correctly.
Complete all three: I ___ Nuru. He ___ Timo. We ___ friends.
interactions.feedback: Mission complete: am, is and are!
interactions.retryHint: I am; he is; we are.
